name: GORRE DINESH CHANDAN R
bio: Tech enthusiast who finds peace in meditation and chaos in badminton matches. Trilingual in English, Hindi, and Telugu, I plot my weekends with the same focus as my coding projects. What’s your go-to guilty pleasure snack? Best answer wins a first date. Go.
